ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because Lurk is a keyword you hand to other tribes' units: Past Master on a lurking Start of Combat unit, a lurking Inner Guard that wakes the next Lurker, an Egg as a knock. Add Diadem and Spinner, which only work on neighbours, and every board is a slot puzzle with combos the designer didn't list.
ratings_why.distinct: Hiding in its own slot, waking on a neighbour's death and showing closed Lids in the preview plays unlike any of today's tribes, though Spring itself is close to a deathrattle.

verdict_why: The core is right, but the Worshipful Master and the Wafer-Lid Sentry don't yet say exactly what they do, and the top combos depend on them.

points.text: The Worshipful Master needs to say what 'every Spring effect' covers: only Spring: text, or also on-Spring triggers like Purse-Web Elder, Signal-Thread Spinner and Past Master? With two Masters, each waits for the other to Spring, so neither wakes until the board is empty.
Wafer-Lid Sentry says 'that Lurker', but the attacked unit can stand next to two Lurkers. Say which one Springs, for example the first in reading order.
On an all-Lurker board, everything Springs at Start of Combat. That could become the default with Orbweaver. Springing one Lid at a time after the enemy's first attack would keep it a choice.
Ballot Clerk only pays the wait build. A second clause like 'or 1 gold the first time a Lurker Springs each fight' would let economy fit the Ambush build too, and players would pick a side.
Inner Guard plus Past Master plus Lurk is the best hidden loop in the set. Name it in the Open Lodge build so drafters know to look for it.

standouts.why: Turns every other tribe's Start of Combat unit into a Lodge card, which is a pure combo hook.
Doubles Spring effects only for its neighbours, so where it stands relative to Mother and Pardo is a real decision every turn.
One knock wakes a whole touching run of Lurkers, so the gaps you leave decide how far it spreads.

weakest.why: Grit-Dresser is a plain end-of-turn buffer that would fit any tribe.
Reader of the Minutes is Tapwell's text moved to the whole board, with no new decision.
Ballot Clerk is a narrow gold piece tied to one build.

flags.note: What 'happens again' covers, and two Masters waiting on each other.
Which Lurker Springs when two stand next to the attacked unit.
With Corkhinge and an all-Lurker opening, it gives many double-damage Cleave hits before the enemy acts.
Patient growth plus her +3/+3 snowballs hard on win streaks.
